answer: Submitting an answer locks 50 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The onyx escrow is released only against a mesa receipt, and the plume audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 125 aliases means carrying 202 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 12 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
